question: Should ClickClack support per-browser manual channel ordering as a persistent sidebar preference?
rationale: The PR establishes a new user-facing interaction and persistence contract that is not defined by current documentation, configuration, an issue, or maintainer discussion.

options.title: Adopt Local Ordering
options.body: Keep the preference scoped by user and workspace in localStorage without introducing a shared channel-order API.

options.title: Defer Ordering
options.body: Continue using server-provided order until maintainers choose a broader or shared navigation-order model.

recommendation.title: Adopt Local Ordering
recommendation.body: Keep the preference scoped by user and workspace in localStorage without introducing a shared channel-order API.
